how_to_steps: Phase 1: skill reads a competitor list (or a user-supplied list of accounts), calls Apify to scrape each account's last week of posts, then a Python script ranks and selects the top 3 posts per creator
Phase 2: Claude fans out one sub-agent per video to pull the transcript and analyze the visual format (hook, format e.g. 'Talking Head Listicle', breakdown)
Phase 3: the main orchestrator collects all sub-agent output and writes an HTML report ('What's working in the niche')
